text:
support_jess: Customer 'Monarch' reported a burst of 504s and p95 tail timeouts hitting our hosted API starting ~08:10 UTC. Several customers affected, high urgency. Please triage.

oncall_eric: ACK, pulling logs and metrics now. Any repro IDs?

support_jess: A few traces attached in the ticket, main tenant id=tenant-987. Seeing 5xx spikes and gateway timeout errors in support logs.

infra_maya: Grafana shows queue_depth for pool hosted-us-east-1b crossing 450 -> 500, continuous_batch_pending queue rising to ~120. Eviction rate and enqueue_delay spiking. Link: https://grafana/redwood/d/queues

eng_lee: Correlating: backlog in continuous-batcher + long context longseq requests from tenant-987 -> KV warmups and batch drain stalls. That will increase per-request latency and cause timeouts at gateway level.

support_jess: Customer impact: several API calls returned 504s. They flagged as production outage. Need mitigation and customer communication.

oncall_eric: Proposed immediate mitigations: 1) apply tenant-level ingress throttle for tenant-987; 2) temporarily raise queue_depth_limit on impacted pool; 3) disable continuous batching for that pool / route to hotpath while we investigate. Rolling now.

ops_bot: runbook:throttle-tenant executed for tenant=tenant-987 by oncall_eric at 2026-03-18T08:14:02Z (status: success)

oncall_eric: Repro steps I used (dev):
```
curl -X POST "https://api.redwood.com/v1/request?model=gpt-large" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -H "X-Tenant-ID: tenant-987" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"input":"<very long prompt...>", "max_tokens":1024}'
```
When queue_length > 450 this consistently produces a 504 within ~30s in our test harness.

eng_lee: Log snippets:
```
2026-03-18T08:12:03Z host=host-23 svc=gateway level=warn msg="enqueue_delay=212ms queue_len=472 cbatch_pending=89 kv_miss=0.82"
2026-03-18T08:12:04Z host=host-23 svc=runtime level=error msg="request_timeout id=abc123 tenant=tenant-987 path=/v1/request duration=301234ms"
```

infra_maya: Telemetry shows kvcache_eviction_rate spiking concurrently with continuous-batching queue growth -> memory churn causing slower per-token throughput.

eng_lee: Short-term code/config changes: add early-reject when queue_depth > 600, add smoothing on enqueue rate changes, and prefer fallback model variant for tenants hitting longseq pattern. I'll open a PR for the runtime patch.

oncall_eric: Applied temporary config changes to mitigate: set max_queue_depth=750 for pool hosted-us-east-1b, set cbatching_enabled=false for the pool, and applied tenant throttle. ops_bot confirms applied.

ops_bot: config-change applied: pool=hosted-us-east-1b cbatching_enabled=false max_queue_depth=750 by oncall_eric (timestamp 2026-03-18T08:15:30Z)

support_jess: Notified customer that we've applied mitigations (throttle + config changes) and are monitoring. They asked for ETA on permanent fix.

eng_lee: Follow-ups: open INF-3245 to implement tenant-aware cbatching disable, queue_depth_rate alert (threshold: >100/s), and early-reject policy. Assign to infra_maya for implementation and runbook updates.

infra_maya: Accepted. Ticket INF-3245 created with steps and rollback notes. Will add dashboard panel and alert.

support_jess: Customer reports drop in 504s after throttle. Thanks team. Will keep them in the loop.

oncall_eric: Monitoring p95 and 5xx for next 2 hours, will escalate if we see reappearance.

eng_lee: Debugging tip for support: ask customers to include header `X-Debug-Trace: 1` when they hit 504s so we can link to trace_id in logs. Also check `X-Request-Queue-Length` and `X-Request-Start` headers returned by gateway.

ops_bot: incident_note: incident_severity=sev3 start=1776543211 mitigation=throttle+config_changes end=1776543320

support_jess: Closing loop for now; will create a short postmortem if this recurs. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
